reports.title: Plug Reports Third Quarter Revenue of ~$201 Million, ~65 Percentage Point YoY Gross Margin Improvement, Record-Low Net Cash Usage with ~54% reduction sequentially

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: Plug remains focused on its 2026 revenue growth guidance of 15% to 16% and its target of positive EBITDAS in Q4 2026, supported by executing on its pipeline, improving margins, continued cost discipline, and overall commercial execution.

Growing energy demand, European regulations and energy security priorities continue to drive hydrogen adoption. These opportunities will be explored at “Plug Symposium 2026: Strengthening Energy Security. Powering Energy Independence.”, a global digital broadcast on November 19, from 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. ET, featuring customers, industry leaders and Plug executives discussing energy security, grid resilience, regulations and real-world hydrogen projects. Register for Plug Symposium 2026 at https://event.on24.com/wcc/r/5510703/EA51E05DFD0F47F65DAD28347B3A226D.
